constitution_basis: Art. X — one canonical authority: an accepted action produces new canonical state ONLY through the engine; the UI renders the record, never its own conclusions.
Art. LXI — infrastructure failure is never a scientific rejection: an unavailable or refused action is an infrastructure/contract state, never a verdict about the candidate.
Art. XXV — unknown stays unknown: while an action is pending, nothing is claimed about its effect.
Directive R458 §2/§4/§5/§18/§27 — no new backend machinery from Coder 2; this contract IS the deliverable; Coder 1 owns execution semantics, Coder 2 owns presentation and invocation.

coder_2_owns: message routing (ASK vs ACT) in the composer
canonical action invocation and payload shape
honest rendering of accepted / refused / not_available outcomes
quick-action affordances mapped to canonical verbs
coder_1_owns: authorization of state-changing actions against the run's canonical state
emission of canonical events for every accepted action's effect
the new canonical state and its provenance after execution
forbidden: frontend-side epistemology (the UI never decides what an action means scientifically)
a second run system or duplicate backend authority
fake success: an action that was not accepted by the engine is never rendered as executed

wire_protocol.status_when_implemented: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED (defined by this contract for Coder 1)

request.action: one of the verbs below (exact string)

202.meaning: engine accepted the action request for execution

409.meaning: engine refused for a recorded reason (e.g. action invalid for current canonical state, run terminal)

404/501.meaning: the engine has not adopted the action endpoint yet — the UI renders the honest-absence copy and changes NOTHING

wire_protocol.auth: X-Tosca-Owner capability header or session cookie (same as every other run-scoped route)
wire_protocol.idempotency: a retried request with the same action_id MUST NOT double-execute

ASK.is: READ-ONLY (already live, NOT part of the new endpoint)
ASK.semantics: answers from the run's own persisted artifacts; honest refusal states (ANSWERED / NOT_IN_RECORD / REFUSED_OVERCLAIM / TRANSPORT_ERROR); never changes canonical state

CLARIFY.is: STATE-CHANGING (already live via C1's R446 §4 pause)
CLARIFY.semantics: the engine's ONE material question; the answer merges as USER_STATED context and resumes the SAME run; never a questionnaire (max one question per pause)
ui_examples: (answering) Outer diameter, keep the current one.

params.focus: optional human phrase describing what to dig into

RESEARCH.semantics: continue the investigation: additional retrieval and reasoning rounds on the current problem

FIND_EVIDENCE.semantics: a targeted retrieval pass; contradictory mode actively hunts disconfirming records (Art. XXXII: state the strongest alternative explanation, then test it)

params.candidates: optional list of candidate ids; default = all live candidates

COMPARE_MECHANISMS.semantics: produce a recorded comparison of the named candidates across evidence support, mechanism coherence, and risk

ATTACK.semantics: run (or re-run) the adversarial stage against the named candidate; outcome enters the canonical record with its existing epistemic vocabulary (SURVIVED / CONTESTED / FAILED / NOT_RUN — never a frontend-inferred verdict)

params.direction: optional human phrase (the user's own words)

CHANGE_MECHANISM.semantics: abandon the current mechanism search direction and synthesize a NEW candidate; preserved constraints are honored; the old candidate's record is untouched (Art. XI)

REQUEST_ENGINEERING.semantics: establish/extend the engineering representation of the current candidate (geometry authority stays CadQuery/OCCT per the settled decision)

REQUEST_EXPERIMENT.semantics: design the falsification experiment for the current candidate (Art. LII contract fields)

UPLOAD_EVIDENCE.semantics: ingested attachments join the run's evidence pool through the SAME relevance/custody gates as retrieved records (Art. XXI: provenance custody; never a side door)

REVIEW_PACKAGE.semantics: navigate to / regenerate the package projection from canonical state (presentation-level; the package is never rebuilt from anything but the record)

event_expectations.accepted_action: Coder 1 emits a product-event for the action's acceptance and for each resulting canonical transition; the conversation renders effects ONLY from those events (one-line progress discipline, §7)
event_expectations.refused_action: the refusal reason renders verbatim in the conversation; no state change; no verdict implied
event_expectations.not_available: the UI renders ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_COPY; nothing changes; the message is preserved in the thread

error_semantics_invariants: BLOCKED != FAILED != UNKNOWN != NOT_RUN != REJECTED != PENDING — the six-word vocabulary stays distinct in every rendering (§8)
'The simulation service was unavailable.' != 'The candidate failed.'
'The adversarial test has not been completed' != 'Survived.'
an accepted action's EFFECT is unknown until the engine records it — the UI says so, in those words

request.file: binary part; any type accepted at the transport layer; ingestion capability is typed per type

body.attachment_id: opaque id, referencable by UPLOAD_EVIDENCE and by POST /api/run {attachment_ids}
body.name: original filename
body.sha256: content hash (provenance custody from the first byte)

responses.404/501: endpoint not live yet — the UI states the limitation honestly and starts nothing

invariants: the browser NEVER reads a file into the problem string (§3 — the conversation references the attachment; it does not become the database)
an UNSUPPORTED_TYPE or FAILED ingestion is disclosed verbatim; nothing is assumed from an un-ingested attachment
ingested documents enter canonical custody (hash + provenance) before any evidence use
startRun accepts attachment_ids: POST /api/run {text, attachment_ids} — backward compatible (the old {text} payload is unchanged when no attachments exist)

client_implementation.router_note_r463: The deterministic phrase router was WIDENED (audit P0-1): the first router's ~9 rigid patterns silently demoted natural-language steering paraphrases to read-only ASK. The R463 router keeps the same contract shape (ordered pattern rules -> canonical verbs, ASK fallback, model-free, presentation-only) with per-verb paraphrase families (objective/constraint steering, alternative-material and mechanism shapes, politeness-prefixed imperatives, prior-art and trade-off probes). Ask vs Act is unchanged; questions about the record still stay ASK. The user's words still ride every action verbatim via buildActionParams -> params.direction.
